blocks.text: SUAL, Pangasinan — The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) in the Ilocos region inaugurated on Tuesday essential facilities aimed at strengthening marine resource protection, improving fisheries monitoring, and increasing the income of local fisherfolk. The agency also turned over livelihood projects to fishery groups in Pangasinan on the same day at the Pangasinan Provincial Fishery Office in this town. The facilities and livelihood projects worth P58,253,292 were funded under the Philippine Fisheries and Coastal Resiliency (FishCoRe) Project, said BFAR Ilocos regional director Remely Lachica.
